lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: YOU’RE REALLY GOING TO RACE THAT RUSTY JUNK [beat] AGAINST MY BRAND NEW PRO-GRADE TURBO SCOOTER FOR THE CHAMPIONSHIP?!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Don't let the exterior fool you Bruno [beat] because my dad didn't just make us scrub the garage floor for sixteen hours straight!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: I told you kids that if you wanted to keep those wheels [beat] you had to learn exactly how the manifold pressure works.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: I can’t believe your dad used to be the local racing legend [beat] and we thought he was just being a grumpy old man this whole time!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Check out the ignition sequence I programmed [beat] while I was supposed to be grounded for hacking the school’s cafeteria menu!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: You guys are dead meat once I hit the straightaway [beat] because my dad spent three thousand dollars on this custom engine!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Money can’t buy the secret nitro-mix [beat] that’s currently coursing through my scooter’s refurbished vintage veins right now!

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: Look at him go [beat] Nix is literally leaving a trail of blue sparks on the pavement while Bruno’s expensive engine starts smoking!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: WHAT IS HAPPENING [beat] MY SCOOTER IS STALLING WHILE THAT PIECE OF GARBAGE IS MOVING LIKE A JET ENGINE!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: That’s what happens when you prioritize shiny paint [beat] over the soul of a machine that’s been tuned with actual greasy hands.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Crossing the finish line never felt so good [beat] especially knowing that our punishment was actually a masterclass in mechanical engineering!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Just don't forget you still have to finish the dishes [beat] or your next upgrade will be a permanent seat on the living room sofa.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And so the Midnight Scooter crew proved that the best upgrades [beat] aren't bought in a store but earned in a messy garage.
